column3: Run the PR security-review workflow exactly as defined in SOUL.md: /opt/data/.local/bin/gh-review.py pending, then for each listed PR fetch its diff with gh-review.py diff, review it against the SOUL.md policy, and submit the outcome with gh-review.py submit. If pending prints nothing, do nothing and answer 'no PRs in scope'.

Run the security-signals digest workflow exactly as defined in SOUL.md: read Kyverno ClusterPolicyReports with kubectl and StackRox alerts from the Central REST API, diff against /opt/data/.work/security-signals/ state, triage anything new, update the state files, and report only new/changed findings.
